types.name: Dictionary order
types.description: Words to be arranged as they would appear in an English dictionary, or asks which word comes first, last or at a given place in dictionary order.

types.name: Logical order
types.description: Words to be arranged in a logical and meaningful sequence (stages of a process, life cycle, small to large) rather than alphabetically.

types.name: Word formation
types.description: Which word can or cannot be made from the letters of a given word, how many meaningful words can be formed from chosen letters, or which word the jumbled letters make.

types.name: Number-coded word
types.description: A number is given to each letter (E = 1, N = 2, T = 3 …) and the question asks which arrangement of numbers spells a meaningful word.

types.name: Alphabet test
types.description: Letters of a word are arranged in alphabetical order, or letters are counted between positions in the English alphabet (how many letters stay in place, which letter lies midway between H and P).
